focused_checks: Bubbles keep widget size while zooming, follow anchors when panning, preserve manually dragged pixel offsets, hide offscreen and restore after fit, and survive 30 hide/show cycles.
Close/clear/replace destroy bubble entries; pending refresh and deferred widget deletion are safe during PlotView destruction. QWidget bubble overlays do not appear in plot exports.
Per-dataset and per-pair settings resolve before preview and execution-plan freeze; saved results and replay use the actual effective parameters.
Applying current-node settings preserves independent point keep/exclude decisions on each dataset. Removing datasets/pairs cleans their overrides; undo restores them.
5000 dataset identities by 7 nodes use shared numerical input and compact parameter differences (metadata under 5 MiB in fixture); no 5000 full numerical workflow stress claim.
Import edits commit automatically; batch column-position application skips a two-column file when a three-column selection is requested, leaving that file unchanged.
Tree moves keep dataset identities; copied processing nodes get new identities; duplicate destination rejection is atomic and undo restores the source tree.
Small-sample Hampel/MAD/bounds, point-review precedence, changed-input fingerprint invalidation, mark/exclude/median and ln/log10/asinh/tanh cases passed.
MTM peak AR1/SWA/FDR indicators use 1/0/-1; absence of a valid test differs from a valid test with no discoveries.
